title: "Studying and references"
format: html
---

***R*** is an open source language with a large, diverse and engaged community. This has also resulted in an enourmous amount of online resources. Finding a good can be a little challenging. Below are som well-written and high quality resources.


[R for Data Science (2e)](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/) is basic curriculum for everyone using R for data science. Use it for lookup or casual reading if you're into that.

[R for Health Data Science](https://argoshare.is.ed.ac.uk/healthyr_book/) provides relevant examples for data analysis in Health Research.

[Healthcare R Book](https://gntem2-q.quarto.pub/healthcare-r-book/) by Thanh G Phan, Monash University, Melbourne. This is a comprehensive book on advanced data analysis in R.


The FreesearchR project is not affiliated with the listed references above.
